additional_info.subject: 0369177 - ID0369177-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002829] OCPP Offline CRM:00658000661
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Oliver,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R0 170002829
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
9bNsBh
Problem Description
: OCPP Offline
Troubleshooting
: Charger logs and Router event logs analyzed
For future reference, your ticket number is
0369177
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We have analyzed charger logs and also checked router event logs remotely and found that charger was offline on OCPP due to "
Network Issue".
We had network disconnection at 11:46 and till 13:01 we had network issue.
During this duration charger was trying to connect with Telekom.de Tele2 operator and was not successful, at 13:01 router was able to connect with Vodafone.de Tele2 operator and then charger came online on OCPP.
Please let us know if you have any other question regarding this.
Awaiting your response.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar
